notes: The 'already in your pantry?' popup is now interactive - tap one of the listed items to add THAT existing item to the shopping list instead of what you typed. Swipe-to-delete needs a firmer, longer left swipe now, so an accidental sideways drift won't delete an item (an Undo still appears either way). And the 'similar item' matching is smarter - it no longer trips on filler words like 'multi', 'max' or 'value', so it stops surfacing unrelated things.
